name: Unova Nights
source:
Unova: a region of myths and legends, great beauty, and endless adventure, but most importantly, cute girls. Come hang out with them, and maybe do some other stuff if you play your cards right, wink wink.

Unova Nights is an anthology of short Pokémon visual novels currently in development.
